transcript.content: Hi, welcome in — I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because when I start eating, it feels like I lose control. I’m telling myself to stop, but I just keep going until I can’t stand it anymore.

After one of these episodes where you feel you've lost control and eaten a lot, do you do anything afterward to try to compensate—like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising excessively?

Yeah. Usually I go find a bathroom—sometimes in my dorm, sometimes somewhere quiet in the library—and make myself throw up. I get terrified that the food is just sitting there and turning into weight.
On average, how many times per week have you been experiencing these binge-eating and vomiting episodes, and for how long has this been happening?
Several times a week, usually. It’s been going on for most of this semester—at least the last few months. I can’t really think of a week when it just stopped.
Can you tell me your current height and weight, or if you know your BMI?
I’m not really sure of my exact weight or BMI. I haven’t checked it recently.
Would you say the way you feel about yourself as a person is heavily tied to your weight or body shape?

Yeah, a lot. I can be having a decent day in class, but then I’ll see myself in a dorm window and think my stomach or face looks bigger than the other guys. It makes me feel like I’ve failed at everything, and I just don’t want anyone to see me.
Can you give me your best estimate of your current height and weight, even roughly, so we can figure out your BMI together?
I really don’t know. I haven’t weighed myself in a while, and I’m not confident enough to guess. I know my height is around average, but I’m not sure exactly.
Have you noticed your clothes fitting looser lately, or has anyone commented that you've lost a noticeable amount of weight recently?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really paid attention to how my clothes fit lately, and nobody’s said anything to me about losing weight.
During these episodes, would you say you're eating an amount of food that's clearly larger than what most people would eat in that same time and situation?

Yeah. There are nights after studying where I’ll eat at the dining hall, then go back to my room and keep eating—burgers, cereal, peanut butter, snacks, whatever I can find. It’s way more than a normal dinner, until the trash is full and I feel sick.
